purpose: Reusable closing conversion band with per-page copy, used on every non-home/contact/legal/404 template

responsive.phone: Full-bleed padding (tablet:px-5 fallback applies from tablet up; phone uses the bare/default horizontal padding), vertical padding tight around the CTA card.
responsive.tablet: Vertical padding grows substantially (tablet:py-[100px]); heading max-width narrows to 560px (tablet:max-w-[560px]) with no card padding (tablet:p-0); heading steps to tablet:text-h3-t.
responsive.desktop: Vertical padding steps to a fixed 24-unit value (desktop:py-24); heading max-width widens to 680px (desktop:max-w-[680px]); heading steps to desktop:text-h3.
